theme_title: Scale, Financialization, and the Owned Economy
title: Asset control over visible operation
rationale: The owner of the land, rail, catalog, or centralized platform is often capturing more value than the frontline operator.

theme_title: Scale, Financialization, and the Owned Economy
title: Roll-up system quality
rationale: Acquisition discipline, shared services, and financing advantages are concentrating fragmented categories.

title: Power-ready industrial capacity
rationale: Power, transmission, cooling, and utility access are re-emerging as industrial selectors.

title: Specified domestic capability
rationale: Categories with procurement sensitivity or security logic are rewarding producers with domestic or nearshore reliability.

title: Adaptive reuse and housing lock-in solutions
rationale: Mobility friction and obsolete commercial space are reshaping local economics.

title: Utility-linked land and logistics corridors
rationale: The right geography is no longer neutral; the scarce site next to the unavoidable flow gets the rent.

title: Power, cooling, and data-center land
rationale: AI demand reprices the physical stack beneath compute before it broadens the software upside.

title: Workflow embedding rather than frontier ownership
rationale: Many winners will come from integrating AI into regulated or routine workflows rather than building the frontier model.

title: Portable admin and worker support layers
rationale: The thinner firm creates demand for outsourced workflow, payroll, credential, and employability support.

title: Training linked to real wage outcomes
rationale: Workers need shorter pathways to employability, and providers need credible links to job placement or earnings gain.

theme_title: Regulated Software and the Admin State
title: Mandatory workflow software
rationale: Compliance, identity, reimbursement, and trust infrastructure keep becoming harder to avoid and easier to monetize.

theme_title: Regulated Software and the Admin State
title: Verification and fraud control
rationale: Institutions need more proof, which creates durable demand for scoring, monitoring, and auditability.

theme_title: Aging, Care, and the Assistance Economy
title: Care coordination and reimbursement fluency
rationale: Demand is real, but the margin pool sits with whoever can navigate staffing, coding, and care orchestration.

theme_title: Aging, Care, and the Assistance Economy
title: Home-first aging infrastructure
rationale: The migration of care into homes and outpatient systems creates a recurring logistics and monitoring bottleneck.

title: Behavioral permission structures
rationale: Consumers still buy indulgence, but categories now need sober-curious, functional, or self-improvement logic around the spend.

title: Health-aligned product mix
rationale: Food, beverage, beauty, and adjacent categories need products that survive under wellness scrutiny.

title: Owned demand and low-friction distribution
rationale: Households are punishing weak middle positioning and rewarding operators that already control traffic, basket economics, and convenience.

title: Private label and value architecture
rationale: Margin defense increasingly depends on making the prudent option feel obvious rather than promotional.

title: Affiliation loops
rationale: Operators that create community and participation can hold demand better than broad goods categories.

title: Scarce venues and programmable experiences
rationale: Pricing power now depends more on curation, social signaling, and repeatable memory creation than on generic capacity.
